lines.text: The final shard settles into place. The artifact is whole for the first time.
It turns once, slowly. A low hum fills the chamber, holds, then stops. The artifact goes still.
That's the last of it. Every shard, seated. It's complete.
It turned, it hummed, and now nothing.
It's finished. And it's listening. For what, I can't say yet.
So it's complete, and we still don't know what it is.
No. The shards taught us how to build it, not what it's for. We keep going out. We're not ready to answer it.
